shape_hint: Cylindrical plug with a flat round collar (diameter dk, thickness c) at the top that seats against the port face (normally with a DIN 7603 sealing ring); below the collar a fully threaded metric fine-pitch shank of length i. A hexagon socket (width across flats s, depth t) is recessed in the top face; there is no external hex head, so total height above the seat is only c. Overall length l = i + c.

role_map.s: hex socket width across flats (nominal, D12)

notes: Metric fine-thread Form A series only (cylindrical thread, sealed by ring under the collar - see sealw for DIN 7603). Pitch shown is the finer series pitch; M30, M36, M42, M45, M48, M52 also exist with P=2 and identical other dimensions. The G (ISO 228-1) variants with the same d2/c/s/t pattern are not in the table. Confirmed against 3 independent sources in every cell (torqbolt, Fuller, fasenco); the German shop dataset (3 sites, one lineage) agrees except for 3 typo cells. Web search quota was exhausted before this family; sources were found by URL pattern from sites already used for plug906/plug910.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched torqbolt, Fuller, fasenco, lexikon live plus fasteners.eu DIN 908 (extra). Parsed torqbolt table 0 (labels P1/P2/G, then k=c, dk, i, lt, e, s, t1), Fuller 9 transposed tables, fasenco table, lexikon (s,t,d2,c), fasteners.eu. 20 rows x 7 cols = 140 cells. Clusters per column (min over rows, without extra source): P 3-4, c 3, dk_max 3, i 3 (torqbolt,Fuller,fasenco only), h 3 (same three), s 3-4, t_min 3-4. Every row agrees with all clusters that carry the cell except German-dataset typos: M14 c=4, M38 dk=42, M56 dk=72, M27 labelled 'M 27 x 1,5', its 'M 52 x 2' column garbled. fasteners.eu agrees with the record in all 140 cells where it has a row (M48 row labelled x2 twice, so M48 P not supported by it). Physical: h=i+c all rows, c/dk/i/h/s/t non-decreasing, dk>s, t<h.
problems: i and h rest on exactly 3 clusters (torqbolt, Fuller, fasenco) - requires Fuller/torqbolt independence (judged independent: transposed min/max layout and 1-decimal e values vs 3-decimal e and mass in torqbolt, no shared typos) and fasenco not being a copy of either. fasteners.eu (extra) gives a 4th explicit match for every i,h cell; recommend adding it.
fasenco calls the part 'Taper Thread' in its text (wrong - DIN 908 is cylindrical); numbers are correct.
Second pitch (x2) rows with identical dimensions exist for M30,M36,M42,M45,M48,M52; record lists finer pitch only (P not a unique key).
Cylindrical G (ISO 228-1) rows share the same d2/c/s/t pattern but are not in the table (OK).
